email.subject: 12 new UI/UX Designer jobs this week
email.body:
This week's openings for designers:

1. UI/UX Designer, fintech, Karachi
2. Senior UI/UX Designer, health tech, Lahore
3. Product Designer, remote

Our salary guide for 2026 is attached.

You are receiving this email because you subscribed to DesignJobs Weekly.
Unsubscribe: https://designjobs.example.com/unsubscribe

why: A newsletter whose subject names the job and which carries a PDF, so the mail search lists it. The free checks must drop it, by its unsubscribe marks, before any AI call.
